name: StockWallpapers
tagline: 在iOS 17体验多代系统壁纸与动态效果。
notice: 仅支持iOS 17.0–17.x。部分画面、动态细节、横屏及强制iPad模式仍在适配。
description: 将iOS 18、26、27的多款系统壁纸接入系统墙纸图库，在系列内切换款式。
当前包含Pride Luminance、Fluidity、Space、Celosia、Flocon、Jurin、Vitra、Marble和V68，共9个系列、42款。
features: 在一个系列内切换不同款式，支持各系列已适配的解锁、唤醒、明暗和动态效果。
提供统一启用开关、Celosia自选颜色、图库刷新和可复制的诊断日志。
改善图库入口刷新与反复打开通知中心后的动态恢复。
设置名称与文案支持简体中文、繁体中文和英文。
compatibility: 提供Rootless／RootHide双包，需要PreferenceLoader及可加载系统插件的越狱环境。
已在iPhone 13 Pro Max／iOS 17.3.1 RootHide确认图库新增系列及Pride动态恢复；Rootless完成构建检查。
其他设备、系统小版本及各系列的完整动态行为仍需验证。
usage: 按越狱环境安装对应包；首次安装建议重新启动越狱环境，确保图库支持加载。
在“设置→系统壁纸”启用，然后进入“设置→墙纸→添加新墙纸→收藏”选择系列和款式。
入口可能稍后出现，先退出并重新进入添加页面，必要时使用插件内的图库刷新工具。
遇到异常可查看并复制诊断日志，说明具体系列、系统版本和出现问题的界面。

changes: 提供9个系列、42种系统壁纸样式，包含iOS 18、26、27的壁纸，当前仅支持iOS 17.x。
优化图库显示与动态恢复，修复入口缺失及反复下拉通知后停止动画的问题。
精简设置并加入图库刷新与诊断，支持简体中文、繁体中文和英文名称及文案。

en.name: StockWallpapers
en.tagline: Enjoy stock wallpaper collections and animations on iOS 17.
en.notice: iOS 17.0–17.x only. Some visuals, animation details, landscape behavior and forced iPad mode remain under adaptation.
description: Brings selected stock wallpapers from iOS 18, 26 and 27 into the system wallpaper gallery, with looks grouped within each family.
Includes Pride Luminance, Fluidity, Space, Celosia, Flocon, Jurin, Vitra, Marble and V68: 9 families and 42 looks.
features: Switch looks within each family and use its supported unlock, wake, appearance and animation effects.
One enable switch, custom Celosia color, gallery refresh and copyable diagnostics.
Improves gallery refresh and animation recovery after repeated Notification Center access.
Settings names and text in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English.
compatibility: iOS 17.0–17.x only; excludes iOS 15, 16 and 18 or later.
Rootless and RootHide packages; requires PreferenceLoader and a jailbreak environment that loads system tweaks.
New gallery families and Pride animation recovery confirmed on iPhone 13 Pro Max/iOS 17.3.1 RootHide; Rootless has build validation.
Other devices, minor OS versions and complete animation behavior across all families still require validation.
usage: Install the package for your jailbreak environment. After first installation, restarting the jailbreak environment is recommended so gallery support is loaded.
Enable Settings→StockWallpapers, then choose a family and look in Settings→Wallpaper→Add New Wallpaper→Collections.
Entries may take time to appear. Reopen the add-wallpaper page first, then use the gallery refresh tools if needed.
For issues, copy the diagnostic log and include the family, OS version and affected screen.

changes: Adds 42 wallpaper looks across 9 families from iOS 18, 26 and 27; iOS 17.x only.
Improves gallery visibility and animation recovery, including missing entries and animations stopping after repeated Notification Center pulls.
Streamlines Settings with gallery refresh and diagnostics, with Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English names and text.
